title: Canadian Cod Chowder
description: A hearty Canadian-inspired fish chowder made with cod, potatoes, and a hint of sweetness from the jelly. Perfect for a cold winter's day.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced potatoes and cook until tender.
Add the cod fillets, chowder mix, and jelly to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10-12 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
